tasks.title: Preflight — regime injection · giveback metrics · architecture alignment
tasks.why: Leadership spec 07 was blocked: BacktestEngine fixed regime=None (B5≡B4), giveback absent from tournament metrics, and architecture docs drifted from implemented B0–B5 and INV registry.
tasks.resolution: Implemented FeatureBuilder.build_regime_series, BacktestEngine(regimes=), peak/terminal/giveback metrics, RollingResult.givebacks and ReturnDistribution giveback_median/q90, harness/CLI/replay wiring; aligned architecture 01/02/07/08/10/11 and specs 00/07/08; SCENARIO-07P-01..06 pass lean_check.
tasks.impact: Phase-1 gate closed: regime reaches B5, rolling distributions report giveback, documentation matches code; unblocks /spec 07_leadership_engine.

tasks.title: Research Harness — backtest engine · rolling distribution · KRX baseline B0–B5
tasks.why: Spec 06 requires a reproducible tournament research harness (next-open execution, cost/participation grids, 36D rolling ReturnDistribution) and real KRX gold-panel baseline distributions before spec 07/08 contract finalization.
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/backtest/{engine,execution,costs,metrics,liquidity}.py, src/alpha/{base,baselines}.py, src/portfolio/{constraints,sizing}.py, src/tournament/{distribution,simulator,replay,harness}.py, and mt-etf backtest/replay CLI; fixed execution-day cost timing and ADV cap; 12 contract scenarios pass lean_check; KRX gold E2E B0–B5 distributions documented in docs/results/06_research_harness_krx_baseline.md.
tasks.impact: L4 research layer operational: rolling 36-session distributions with P(R>θ), CVaR, RTS, n_effective; cost×participation stress grid wired; KRX 2024–2026 baseline anchors for spec 07/08 /spec (B2 P>30%=0.091, B1 vs B2 concentration trade-off); regime wiring for B5 remains follow-up.

tasks.title: Feature Engine — PIT guard · momentum · flow · breadth · regime · gold panel
tasks.why: Silver ETF panel needs session-aligned, PIT-safe feature columns (momentum, trend, volatility, flow decomposition, cross-sectional ranks) persisted to gold for downstream research and model input.
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/features/{pit,momentum,trend,volatility,flow,crosssec,breadth,regime,builder}.py, configs/features.yaml, and mt-etf features CLI: assert_pit on every public function, align_session_grid, AUM flow identity, FeatureBuilder.build_panel/snapshot, gold Parquet write; 11 contract scenarios pass lean_check.
tasks.impact: L3 feature layer operational: mt-etf features --start --end writes features/etf_features.parquet; INV-05-1/2/4 shift-invariance and cross-sectional universe masking tested; regime/breadth wired via FeatureBuilder helpers.

tasks.title: Point-in-Time Universe — instrument master · taxonomy · eligibility
tasks.why: Silver panel alone cannot answer which ETFs are tradable at as_of: survivorship-safe existence, sponsor whitelist, ADV liquidity, and leverage-family metadata must be enforced before alpha research.
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/universe/{instruments,families,taxonomy,tournament,provider}.py, configs/taxonomy.yaml, and mt-etf universe CLI: ordered existence→price→history→sponsor→liquidity→eligibility filters, deployment fail-closed sponsor/manifest, PIT ADV and as-of name resolution, LeverageFamilyIndex; 20 contract+invariant scenarios pass.
tasks.impact: L2 universe layer operational: mt-etf universe --date --mode structural|deployment; INV-4/6/20 partially enforced at universe gate; INV-17 deferred to portfolio (max_per_family).

tasks.title: Silver Panel — schema decode · validation gates · normalize CLI
tasks.why: Bronze JSON must become typed, fail-closed silver Parquet: empty-string→None decoding, valid_price_ratio session classification, accounting-identity checks, robust tradability flags, and architecture-mandated no_future_dates gate before disk write.
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/data/{schema,silver,validation}.py, kst_today in src/core/calendar.py, and normalize CLI: DatasetSchema per-endpoint decode, classify_session (ρ≥0.5), PanelValidator V2–V10 (duplicate key, identity, no_future_dates CRITICAL), SilverBuilder incremental/full idempotent build with zstd Parquet; 12 contract scenarios pass.
tasks.impact: L1 silver layer operational: mt-etf normalize produces validated etf_daily Parquet under data/normalized/; CRITICAL validation blocks contaminated panels; INV-1/2 and integrity gates (duplicate key, future date) enforced at Bronze→Silver conversion.

tasks.title: KRX Ingestion — provider · rate limit · bronze · resumable backfill
tasks.why: KRX Open API returns HTTP 200 for semantic failures; ingestion must preserve raw payloads write-once, enforce per-second rate limits and daily quota, and resume without re-fetching completed sessions.
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/data/providers/{base,krx,ratelimit}.py, src/data/{bronze,backfill}.py, and ingest CLI wiring: KRXOpenAPIProvider (basDd-only, verbatim rows, permanent/transient retry), BronzeStore write-once, QuotaLedger + RateLimiter, BackfillPlanner/run_backfill with bounded concurrency; Settings.requests_per_second=5.0; 10 contract scenarios pass.
tasks.impact: L1 data layer operational: mt-etf ingest supports dry-run and resumable backfill; bronze JSON preserved under data/raw/krx/**; daily quota tracked in data/state/krx_quota.json.

tasks.title: Core Spine — settings, calendar, paths, logging, CLI
tasks.why: Stage-1 foundation: typed Settings, XKRX calendar, DataPaths traversal guard, structured logging, and mt-etf CLI spine required by all downstream specs.
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/core/{settings,sops_env,calendar,paths,logging_setup}.py and src/cli.py with SUBCOMMANDS registry; secrets load from .env.enc via sops (no plain .env); 12 unit tests pass; architecture docs updated.
tasks.impact: L0 core layer operational: config-check and calendar subcommands verified; KRX API auth works via in-memory sops decrypt; code_map and task_index registered.
